verdict.rationale: Cactus is an inference engine with OpenAI-compatible APIs, so serving-throughput techniques are a fair axis for it. The evidence pack never mentions continuous batching, chunked prefill or multi-request serving throughput. The only performance-related items are a benchmark command and anecdotal on-device speed reports, which do not show either capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can achieve high serving throughput via continuous batching and chunked prefill
